lines: Well, I'll be. One minute I'm countin' Fluffkins, the next I'm fallin' out of a green sky.
I'm Heather, sugar. You alright? You look about as rattled as a fence post in a twister.
(She looks round at the Void folk, all staring.) Folks round here look plum scared of us. Reckon we oughta say hello proper.
Well, hey there, sugar! Ain't you just the sweetest thing. I'm Heather.
{player}: Melody's written a new song, and she won't sing it without you!
A new song? Well, why didn't you say so! Hold onto your hat, I'm comin'! (She hops on her scooter.) Meet you at the Market, hon!
Go on, sugar, the Market Square! Melody gets awful nervous if I'm not in the front row.
(Heather trots up, tail swishing.) Well, howdy, sugar! You know what I've been thinkin'?
A body can't mend a whole glen and then go off adventurin' all by their lonesome. Can I tag along with you?
And when you need some rain, or a rainbow to walk on, you just press {showers} and I'll call up some April Showers.
Yay! I'll be right behind you. Press {friend} any time you need me!
That's OK! I'll ask again another time.
Still want me along? I'm ready when you are!
Yay! I'll be right behind you. Press {friend} any time you need me!
That's OK! I'll ask again another time.
Well, hey there, sugar! Ain't you just the sweetest thing.
I'm Heather. I came up from a little farm a long, long way from here. Or a long, long WHEN from here. I'm still workin' that out.
{player}: Do you like it here?
I sure do! The grass tastes like candy floss, and Bramble lets me help in the gardens on her busy days.
{player}! Did you see? My blossom trees came through the portal after you! There's a whole orchard by Glenmoor's door now.
And two of the Fluffkins snuck through with 'em. Little rascals. They seem happy grazin' under the blossom though.
And Isla says the Moonfolk are teachin' my Sunfolk the stars. Ain't that somethin'?
Don't forget your April Showers, sugar: {showers_how} and there's a rainbow after. And hop as you land for a Spring Step!
Mornin'! This meadow's got the springiest grass in the whole town. Go on, give it a bounce.
Back home I'd be up before the rooster. Here I just get up when the sky turns green.
Watch this! (Heather kicks off on her scooter and spins round.) Ha! Moo-ve over, Dash!
Zippy says I'm a natural. I say I'm just stubborn. Same thing, mostly.
I like to sit by the water at the end of the day. It looks just like the pond on the farm, if the pond glowed. And had aliens in it.
Portal's open, hon. Ain't that somethin'?

rotate: My best friend's from Scotland. She says 'wee' and I say 'y'all'.
Put us together and we're a whole dictionary!
Bramble says I'm the only person she knows who can out-stubborn a carrot.
When I miss home, I hum a farm song. Want to hear? ...Moooo. That's the whole song.
